approach: Add a rule to the plan gate, next to the open-questions rule in `plan_findings`, that refuses a plan which hands caller and test discovery to the producer. A shared helper `defers_to_producer(text)` normalizes the text (lowercase, `*` and backticks removed, whitespace split into words) and matches two forms: the word `producer`, then one or more auxiliaries (to, should, will, must, needs, has, also, then, can, may), then a discovery verb (check, verify, search, find, grep, determine, or `look for`); and the fixed phrases `left to the producer`, `leave to the producer`, `leave it to the producer`. Discovery verbs only, so a procedural mitigation such as 'the producer must read the computed figure' passes. `risks_findings` applies the helper to each risk's text and mitigation and emits one major Athena finding per offending risk at location `risks`. `dependents_deferral_findings` applies the same helper to each dependent's `test` and `reason` and emits one major Athena finding per offending dependent at `dependents, dependent N`, so the deferral cannot move into the section the planner brief points to. Both are called from `plan_findings` after `open_questions_findings`, and a major finding returns the plan to the planner without a critic call. The doc comment names the root cause: planning was never required to settle caller and test impact, and risks and dependents could say 'producer to check'. One line in `planner.md` tells the planner to search the tests and other crates for callers, `include_str!` or fs reads of moved files and output assertions, to list them in `dependents`, and never to defer them. The `budget planner` line in `docs/system-facts.md` is updated to the computed value. Tests: two unit tests in `admission.rs` and a table in `refusal_corpus.rs` `mod plan_side`, whose case shape carries a list of risks and a dependent's test and reason, so an empty risks list is representable.

decisions.choice: Fix at `plan_findings` with a new risks rule plus a dependents-deferral rule, sharing one helper `defers_to_producer`, and add one brief line to planner.md.
decisions.reason: `open_questions_findings` (admission.rs:331) never looks at risks, and its doc (admission.rs:325-326) says the caller listing 'stays prose in the planner brief'. Both failed jobs passed the gate with impact left to the producer. The planner brief tells the planner to put callers in `dependents`, so a rule on risks alone would push the deferral into `dependents`: `dependents_findings` (admission.rs:410) accepts any non-blank test or reason. Scanning both places closes the class.

rejected.why: Prose alone is what failed twice; the user default 'mechanism' requires enforcement in code.
The critic's finding 2 shows the deferral would move into a dependent's reason, and job 20261026-193430-avnq's miss was a dependents miss (a reader of display.rs nobody searched for).

rejected.option: Search the repository mechanically for callers and compare with `dependents`
rejected.why: Out of scope: `plan_findings` has no repository access, and the request says the search stays the planner's.

rejected.option: Refuse any risk that mentions the producer, or any non-empty risks list
rejected.why: Too blunt. 'The producer runs cargo test' is a legitimate mitigation; the rule must not be blanket.

decisions.choice: Match with a token scan, not a regex: after normalizing, find the word `producer`, skip one or more auxiliaries, and require a discovery verb: check, verify, search, find, grep, determine, or `look` followed by `for`. Add the fixed phrases `left to the producer`, `leave to the producer`, `leave it to the producer`.
decisions.reason: This answers finding 3: the earlier verb list (read, confirm, review, inspect, look) would have refused 'the producer must read the computed figure from the budgets test failure' and 'the producer must confirm cargo fmt passes', which defer no caller or test discovery. Over-refusal is costly because MAX_MECHANICAL_PASSES is 2 (planning.rs:437) and the job stops after that. Skipping several auxiliaries also catches 'producer should also check'. This is the same transparent phrase-list style as `says_code_answers` and `has_addressee` (admission.rs:358-379), so the corpus can pin it.

rejected.why: False positives on ordinary procedural mitigations, shown by the two Accept cases added to the corpus.

rejected.option: Require a discovery object (caller, test, reader) near the verb
rejected.why: More heuristics to get wrong; the narrowed verb list is simpler and still matches every deferral seen in the two jobs.
No regex dependency is needed, and the corpus cannot pin the behavior as plainly.

rejected.option: Also match 'up to the producer' and a bare 'for the producer to'
rejected.why: They also appear in legitimate non-discovery sentences ('up to the producer to choose the name'); the reading does not list them.

decisions.choice: One finding per offending risk at location exactly `risks`, summary 'Risk N defers its impact to the producer: <risk text>'. One finding per offending dependent at `dependents, dependent N`, summary 'Dependent N (<name>) defers its impact to the producer: <text>'. Each is Major and from Athena. Both the risk text and the mitigation are scanned, as are both the dependent's test and reason.
decisions.reason: The acceptance criterion states location 'risks' for risks. The dependents location matches the existing `dependents, dependent N` form (admission.rs:397), and the corpus already accepts any location starting with 'dependents' (refusal_corpus.rs:2544). Scanning both fields covers deferral in the risk text rather than the mitigation, which the reading lists as an input form.

rejected.option: Put dependent findings at `risks` too, for one location
rejected.why: The finding should point the planner at the field to fix; `dependents, dependent N` already exists as a location.

decisions.reason: Finding 4: a single risk and mitigation string cannot hold the empty-list case. A list holds it directly and keeps one table for risks and dependents.

demonstrations.fails_without: Without the system-facts update, `system_facts_budgets_match_computed` fails. Without the rule none of the new tests pass.
demonstrations.seam: Whole-workspace run, no double. Existing tests that reach `plan_findings` indirectly with empty risks are the regression check.
